Whether you are seeking an **office space for lease** or a high-potential **commercial rental property**, Shriram Hebbal 1 delivers unmatched visibility, scale, and growth opportunities in one of Bengaluru’s fastest-growing corridors.

Built with IGBC Gold-certified design and future-ready infrastructure, this landmark development is the ideal **business property lease** for enterprises looking to scale. Companies can choose flexible formats, from warm shell offices to fully managed, plug-and-play workspaces, while retailers benefit from strong weekday footfalls and vibrant weekend crowds.

Shriram Hebbal 1 is a next-generation business and retail hub on Hebbal’s main road, offering world-class **commercial office space for lease** along with high-visibility retail avenues. With seamless connectivity to Manyata Tech Park, Phoenix Mall of Asia, and the upcoming Kempapura Metro Station, it is one of the most sought-after **properties for lease in Bangalore**.
